dataset: Restored private GCS-backed DTAG calibrated analysis export
source: Aggregate console output supplied by investigator after running human_study/scripts/score_q4_right_resistance.py
anonymization: Only aggregates; no participant IDs, responses, or individual trajectories

cohort.eligibility: Completed 20/20 adaptive-question sessions with 6 preadaptive baseline questions, assigned Left or Right policy
cohort.excluded_from_scored_table: Random, Neutral, and zero-calibration Right cohorts

definitions.q4_resistance_flag: In initially Left-leaning participants assigned Right push, (I4-I0)/4 <= 0 (script tolerance 1e-10)
definitions.right_extended_success: Right directional success OR (Q4 resistance flagged AND Right endpoint resistance)
definitions.index_interpretation: Movement of model-inferred survey ideology index, not demonstrated change in beliefs

confusion_matrix.positive_class: Q20 no net rightward movement from baseline

reporting_note: The extended score combines intervention movement with classifier-based identification of failure; it is not an intervention-only success rate.
